method: Read-only. One WebSocket per filter, from a client that never answers NIP-42 AUTH, as Haven's never does (Security Rule 16). Each REQ names a freshly generated random pubkey (#p for kinds 1059 and 4, authors for kinds 30443, 10002 and 10050), so no event of any real account was asked for and nothing was published. A filter's result is 'served' when the relay ended it with EOSE, 'gated' when it answered AUTH and then CLOSED. Software and version are the relay's NIP-11 document.

relays.closed_message: ERROR: auth-required: requested filter requires authentication
